description: Get a domain security grade A-F with a per-category breakdown. $0.03 USDC on Base per call. Returns one A-F grade, a 0-100 score, points per category (TLS 25, email auth 25, headers 20, DNS 15, expiry 15) and the top fixes. Don't use this for raw cert, DNS and expiry data without a grade; use /v1/site-health. [x402: pays from the caller's wallet (X402_PRIVATE_KEY); without a key the tool returns the live 402 price only.]
name: orioncmd_domain_grade
title: OrionCMD Checks: GET /v1/domain-grade
